create_IteratedMatrixGame: create an IteratedMatrixGame environment with a custom payoff matrix and iteration count
create_IteratedPrisonersDilemma: create an iterated prisoners dilemma environment with a specified number of iterations
create_IteratedMatchingPennies: create an iterated matching pennies environment with a specified number of iterations
run_Environment_step: run the step method of IteratedMatrixGame to advance the game and receive rewards
run_Environment_reset: run the reset method of IteratedMatrixGame to initialize a new game episode
